test_title: PYST 42: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a code language, VACCINE is written as (132)/(7) and MASKS is written as (72)/(5).

How will SANITIZE be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given codes is:

**Sum of opposite positional value of all the alphabets ÷**** Number of alphabets = Code**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eee81f47ce91dba2049f48274c9475ff65dc36a546ad03e46beb7512eafe3e56.png] 132 ÷ 7 = (132)/(7)

and,.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f9149fa1cd52a3b6519da5728ca0fca380a3578da7d39a760114d61333563fc.png] 72 ÷ 5 = (72)/(5)

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09d653cd512c2d249667328db23700f379c8da4f995fc06f7ff36d785fec293f.png] 113 ÷ 8 = (113)/(8)

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**
